name: MART 451 - Module 3
author: Kuzco_Llama
description:
Improvements (based on feedback):
Adjusted the height of the blocks to make it easier to jump.
Made the start running button enter instead of a movement button.
Moved the camera a bit farther back so you can see a little more.

JUICE updates:
Added SFX to everything. (So be sure to unmute!)
Added VFX to things like deaths and some other stuff.
Updated all textures and the skybox.
Plus some other minor stuff and scripts.
